_about: Edwin Hatch (1835-1889), Oxford church historian: The Influence of Greek Ideas and Usages upon the Christian Church (Hibbert Lectures 1888, Gutenberg) and Essays in Biblical Greek (1889). His church-order lectures (Organization of the Early Christian Churches, Growth of Church Institutions) are church history, left for lane A; the Hatch-Redpath Septuagint Concordance is a reference index.
